 - Checking and preparing orders for shipment
 - Receiving and storing incoming goods with the reach truck
 - Keeping the warehouse clean and organized
 - Following safety protocols
 - Cleaning and inspecting transportation equipment
 - Supporting periodic stock counts
 
 
 You will work in a brand new, dry, and temperature-controlled warehouse. Training is provided on the job, and you will be part of a close-knit and professional team.
Requisitos - European Union nationality.
 - English level A2/B1.
 - Driving license.
 - Valid Forklift/Reachtruck license.
 - Previous experience as a Forklift Operator
 - Immediate availability.
 
Qué ofrecemos - Rotating shifts within these time frames:
Monday to Friday: 00:00 to 24:00
Weekends: 00:00 to 24:00
Possibility of extra hours on weekends during periods of high demand.
 - Base salary of 14.99€/h gross + vacation supplement + BONUS for extra shifts
 - Accommodation and transportation provided.
 - Assistance with BSN management and medical insurance.
